profile.reading: K-Motion Interactive is a sports-technology company that makes 3D motion-capture and biomechanics analysis systems used in golf and baseball swing instruction, based in the Scottsdale area of Maricopa County, Arizona. The coordinates on file sit within the McDowell Mountain Business Park, a multi-tenant office and light-industrial park, and a check of the address today finds a different small business occupying that specific building. There is no indication that K-Motion, or any current tenant at this location, operates server rooms, colocation space, or dedicated data center infrastructure here. This entry describes the business as it is known publicly rather than presenting an ordinary office address as a data center facility.

reading.body:
A mistagged OpenStreetMap point put a Scottsdale sports-technology company into Arizona's data center inventory, and it contributes zero megawatts to the state's published capacity.

The pattern is a mapping error, not a facility. K-Motion Interactive makes 3D motion-capture and biomechanics systems for golf and baseball instruction. The stored coordinates resolve to a multi-tenant office and light-industrial building in McDowell Mountain Business Park, where a different small business now operates. No server rooms, colocation space, or dedicated compute infrastructure are present.

This matters for AI because capacity inventories are only as good as their tagging. Arizona has 56 mapped facilities, and only 4 of them publish power figures, totaling 512 MW. A false positive inflates the count of sites without adding a single megawatt, which makes the mapped total look broader than the powered total actually is. The gap between 56 facilities and 4 published figures is the real story here, and this entry sits on the wrong side of it.

What the data does not show is how many other entries share this problem. One mistag is documented, and the research note says the other 8 rows in the same batch are independently mistagged small businesses scattered across the Phoenix metro rather than co-located facilities. That suggests the error is systematic in origin, but the data covers only this batch and cannot say how far it extends.
